title: Kingdom 3rd Season

alternative_titles.ja: キングダム 第3シリーズ

synopsis:
Following the successful Sanyou campaign, the Qin army, including 1,000-Man Commander Xin, inches ever closer to fulfilling King Ying Zheng's dream of unifying China. With a major geographical foothold in the state of Wei now under its control, Qin sets its sights eastward toward the remaining warring states.

Meanwhile Li Mu—an unparalleled strategist and the newly appointed prime minister of the state of Zhao—has taken advantage of Zhao's temporary truce with Qin to negotiate with the other states without interruption. Seemingly without warning, Ying Zheng receives news that armies from the states of Chu, Zhao, Wei, Han, Yan, and Qi have crossed into Qin territory. Realizing too late the purpose behind Li Mu's truce with Qin, Zheng quickly gathers his advisors to devise a plan to address the six-state coalition army on their doorstep. For the first time in history, the state of Qin faces complete destruction and must use every resource and strategy at their disposal to prevent themselves from being wiped off the map.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: The Encroaching Coalition Army
episodes_data.description: All`s quiet in the kingdom of Qin until not one, but three armies attack--and, as a steady stream of messengers reveals, that`s just the half of it.

episodes_data.title: A Coming Together
episodes_data.description: Cai Ze gets a royal audience in hopes of using diplomacy to save Qin. Xin tags along with Lord Biao`s army. Lord Changping works to find a solution.

episodes_data.title: The Battle of Hangu Pass
episodes_data.description: Qin sends its troops to defend Hangu Pass, sole gateway to the kingdom. An impressive array of military might is on display as the battle kicks off.

episodes_data.title: Two Battlefields
episodes_data.description: Lord Biao`s army finds itself in a bad situation soon after fighting begins. The Wei army brings in equipment that has Zhang Tang rolling his eyes.

episodes_data.title: Rise of a Young General
episodes_data.description: As the Wei army tackles the mighty Hangu Pass, the allied army of Meng Wu and Teng are battling the Chu army--and there are old scores to be settled.

episodes_data.title: A Mutual Self-Confidence
episodes_data.description: Xiang Yi brings out his favorite weapon: a legendary sword. Teng takes on the fierce Chu general Lord Linwu. Xin faces a Zhao army with a grudge.

episodes_data.title: A Wasteland Riddled with Holes
episodes_data.description: The horrors of Changping nearly two decades ago have spurred Wan Ji and his army to seek revenge against Qin, with Xianyang slated for annihilation.

episodes_data.title: Wa Lin, the Military Genius
episodes_data.description: A new commander takes over Chu`s second army, bringing along a new strategy and a lot of confusion. The grotesque Cheng Hui of Han makes his move.

episodes_data.title: Meng Wu's Proclamation
episodes_data.description: Rumors about Qin reach Qiang Lei on her journey. Li Mu calculates the best time to strike, and the Battle of Hangu Pass reaches its turning point.

episodes_data.title: A Promotion in a Predicament
episodes_data.description: Teng makes a bold decision when his army finds themselves in a bind. Cheng Hui`s move pays off. Wei`s Wu Fengming has another trick up his sleeve.

episodes_data.title: A General's Pride
episodes_data.description: As Cheng Hui`s poison courses through Zhang Tang`s body, the mighty Qin general takes advantage of Huang Yi`s cunning strategy and enters the fray.

episodes_data.title: The Wa Lin Army's Charge
episodes_data.description: Qin general Wang Jian seemingly vanishes, army and all, mid-skirmish with Wu Lu Duo and the Yan army. Chu`s newest commander goes after Teng`s head.

episodes_data.title: The Strongest
episodes_data.description: Meng Wu repeats his daring echelon sweep against Chu, but with a twist. Chu`s massive Han Ming faces off against Meng Wu in a battle for the ages.

episodes_data.title: The Mightiest Man
episodes_data.description: Wa Lin devises a way to hurry along the generals` duel. Li Mu and Lord Chunshen discuss a new strategy, while Wa Lin shows her hand at long last.

episodes_data.title: Beyond Hangu Pass
episodes_data.description: The Qin army is riding high when Wa Lin`s elites arrive at Hangu Pass. An unpredictable Qin general steps in to assist. Diao is cautiously optimistic.

episodes_data.title: Li Mu's Whereabouts
episodes_data.description: The royal capital of Xianyang is feeling the heat as outpost after outpost falls in the south of Qin. The most ominous question: Where has Li Mu gone?

episodes_data.title: The Ultimate Instinctive Type
episodes_data.description: Qin`s Lord Biao confronts Li Mu at the center of his clever whirlpool trap, where he meets a savage warrior with a history of battling great generals.

episodes_data.title: Zheng's Decision
episodes_data.description: Xianyang is in disarray as Li Mu`s army approaches and King Zheng goes missing. Qin formulates a strategy around a southern outpost--its last hope.

episodes_data.title: Zheng Speaks
episodes_data.description: It`s up to King Zheng to convince the people of Zui to fight, defending Xianyang and Qin itself. Li Mu`s arrival makes them second-guess themselves.

episodes_data.title: The First Night
episodes_data.description: The first day of any battle is a high hurdle to clear, even without civilian troops. Li Mu employs unique tactics overnight to gain the upper hand.

episodes_data.title: A Secret Revealed
episodes_data.description: Xin`s training with Qiang Lei comes in handy at Zui. Zheng continues to rally the civilian and veteran troops--until something goes terribly wrong.

episodes_data.title: With All We Have
episodes_data.description: The castle town of Zui is struggling to stand strong in their drawn-out battle, suffering serious setbacks that put Li Mu on the path to victory.

episodes_data.title: Unprecedented Aid
episodes_data.description: Reinforcements arrive for Qin, and not a moment too soon. But even the most ferocious mountain warriors are no match for one of Zhao`s Three Greats.

episodes_data.title: Deepest Gratitude
episodes_data.description: An exhausted Xin draws on what remains of his strength to face Pang Nuan. The end of the war with the coalition army is in sight, but at what cost?

episodes_data.title: The Difference Between Dances
episodes_data.description: A post-campaign award ceremony is held in Xianyang. The Fei Xin Force heads to their next posting. Qiang Lei meets a clanswoman with welcome news.

episodes_data.title: Another Path
episodes_data.description: Qiang Lei must dance more intently than ever before, putting her life on the line for a chance at besting the Chi You and avenging Xiang`s death.

background: Kingdom 3rd Season adapts chapters 261-364 of the original manga.
